map.把 JSON 键变标签、值变文本/子节点，数组转重复标签。适合把现代接口数据推给: Turn JSON keys into tags and values into text / child nodes, with arrays becoming repeated tags. Suited to pushing modern interface data to systems that only accept XML. Converted locally.
map.对接 SOAP/老系统: Interfacing with SOAP or legacy systems
map.数组元素用同一标签名重复: Array elements repeat the same tag name
map.无键的值需给默认标签: Values without keys need a default tag
map.同一标签重复出现即可，如 <i>1</i><i>2</i>。: Repeating the same tag works, such as 12.
map.→ 去使用 JSON 转 XML（免费 · 纯前端 · 数据不上传）: -> Go use JSON to XML (free · pure front end · data never uploaded)
